items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: I could always play easily with Gary Peacock, Red Mitchell.

ctx.x: Somebody you can groove with. You know it’s nice to really work with some bass players. I could always play easily with Gary Peacock, Red Mitchell. We had to work at it for a while but we stuck with it and eventually became very good together. Then I fortuitously moved across the street from Leroy Vinnegar in the Hollywood Hills and he befriended me and then I played with his group. So I was always playing with really good bass players or as much as I could. But after I played with Leroy it’s like I could get…
Is there such a thing as playing on top of the beat or behind the beat without changing the tempo?
